description: This file implements a Node.js script that acts as a proxy for MCP commands, decoding payloads, conditionally injecting MCP server data into certain methods, and managing a child process to execute a target command line.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines if a method should be injected with MCP server data based on its name.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Parses a JSON line, and if applicable, injects MCP server info into specific methods.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current module is the main module being executed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up IPC pipes, spawns the target command, and manages data flow.
